entities.name: Boris Ryzhy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Boris Borisovich Ryzhy was a Russian poet and geologist. Some poems by Ryzhy have been translated into English, Italian, German, Dutch and Serbian. He died by suicide on 7 May 2001, at the age of 26. He was born in Chelyabinsk, but had lived in Sverdlovsk since 1980.
